basicInfo.name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
basicInfo.flavor: Zenitsu is a fellow Demon Slayer who joined the Demon Slayer Corps at the same time as Tanjiro. He is a wielder of \"Thunder Breathing.\" Zenitsu is extremely timid and fearful by nature and faints when overcome by sheer terror, allowing him to unleash his true prowess. He possesses hearing that is superior to that of an average person and is very fond of women.

Normal Attack.desc:
Single Enemy
 - Deals damage equal to 130% of Physical Attack 1 time(s).
 - 30% chance to inflict 1 Buff Removal(s).
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 130% of Physical Attack.

Skill 1.desc:
Single Enemy
 - 100% chance to inflict 3 Buff Removal(s).
 - Deals Piercing, Defense-Ignoring damage equal to 287% of Physical Attack 2 time(s).
 - Activates again up to 1 time(s) with 100% power upon defeating an enemy with this skill.
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 287% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Each attack has a 70% chance to inflict Shock. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]

Skill 2.desc:
All Enemies
 - 100% chance to inflict Buff Duration Reduction. [Reduced by: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Deals Defense-Ignoring damage equal to 60% of Physical Attack 2 time(s).
 - 100% chance to inflict Defense Reduction. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Damage: To 60% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Each attack has a 35% chance to inflict Shock. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]

Passive.desc:
Self
 - Grants Blessing. [Always Active]
 - Grants a Barrier equal to 160% of the caster's Physical Attack. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]
 - Grants All Debuff Removal (Crowd Control) upon being inflicted with Crowd Control.
 - *Grants the following effects when a debuff is removed.
 - Grants Crowd Control Immunity. [Duration: 1 Turn(s)]
 - Grants 25 Awakening Gauge Boost
 - Allies (Attack)
 - Grants Crit Rate Boost. [Always Active]
 - All Enemies
 - Inflicts Effect Resist Reduction. [Always Active]
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Increases Effect: Barrier absorption becomes equal to 160% of Physical Attack.
Transcend Lv.2 Effect
 - Self
 - Adds Effect: Grants a Skill Cooldown Reduction of 26s when a debuff is removed.
 - Adds Effect: Grants a Barrier equal to 95% of the caster's Physical Attack when a debuff is removed. [Duration: 3 Turn(s)]

Awaken Skill.name: Thunder Breathing Seventh Form: Honoikazuchinokami
Awaken Skill.desc:
2 Enemies with the Highest Attack
 - 100% chance to inflict Buff Duration Reduction. [Reduced by: 2 Turn(s)]
 - Deals Defense-Ignoring damage equal to 215% of Physical Attack 2 time(s).
 - Instant Execution of an enemy with 26% or lower HP.
Skill Enhancement Effect
 - Adds Effect: 100% chance to inflict Buff Duration Reduction. [Reduced by: 2 Turn(s)]
Transcend Lv.6 Effect
 - Adds Effect: Each attack has a 40% chance to inflict Shock. [Duration: 2 Turn(s)]

profile.likes: Sweets and expensive foods (such as eel)
